init.title: FlowPilot options
init.description: Assistants that use a FlowPilot text-to-speech entity hear the speech of the FlowPilot graph.

data.duck_media: Quiet media while a satellite listens
data.timer_device: Speaker for timers and alarms from chats

data_description.fallback_tts: Speaks what FlowPilot has no speech for: answers of local intents, satellite announcements, tts.speak, and graphs without text-to-speech.
data_description.duck_media: When a satellite hears its wake word, the playing media players of its area get quieter until the command is heard. Only players in Home Assistant with the satellite's area count.
data_description.duck_level: Percent of the player's volume while the satellite listens.
data_description.duck_fallback: What to do with players that cannot change their volume.
data_description.duck_exclude: Media players that keep their sound, such as the satellite's own speaker in another integration.
data_description.timer_device: Where the timers and the alarms set from a conversation without a speaker of its own (Telegram, the Assist chat) ring when the person did not name a speaker. Not set: the only speaker that can, or the agent asks which.
